static_traits.name: 陈可怡
static_traits.medical_history: not yet曾接受心理治疗，No major physical illness史

basic_info.main_problem: 我在大一的文学课考试中not及格，由于对可能not得not退学的想法感到overwhelmed。
basic_info.core_demands: The fear of failure and dropping out makes it hard for me to bear alone, so I seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/not配在这里

special_situations.event: 收到文学课考试not及格的成绩
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次考试失败，就说明我not适合读大学、I am not smart enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍学习以证明自己，同时Reduced socializing以避免被评价

special_situations.event: 面对学业挑战或收到老师/课程的表现反馈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能持续表现优异，就等于彻底失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一次失败意味着以后我都会失败

special_situations.event: 进入大学后压力与要求显著升高的过渡期
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立刻很好适应大学节奏，就说明I am not good enough、not配在这里
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 强迫自己更努力学习、试图达到完美
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not smart enough，可能without法应付更难的课程

special_situations.event: 在完成某次作业时开始恐慌
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次作业做not好，就证明我整体学业能力not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 陷入过度担忧、减少与朋友互动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会再次失败，情况只会越来越糟

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable and good enough, to stay securely at university and complete my studies
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败导致被negate、被视为not够好，从而失去not yet来与价值感
defense_goal: 通过保持高标准与追求完美来避免被negate
Reduced socializing来降低被他人评判的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够聪明、随时可能失败的Student
object_relations.object_representation: 严苛的评判者（大学环境/他人/评价体系）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about or facing discussion and evidence examination of 'whether failure can determine overall ability'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向以理性分析与抽象化来与情绪保持距离，避免被not堪体验淹not
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、Empathy与验证感受，use开放式问题引导具体化体验，鼓励同时承认理性与情绪两方面，避免争辩与评判。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing others' feedback or possible evaluation (exam scores, homework grading, peer discussions)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人与环境视为“全好或全坏”的评判者，认为自己一旦not够好就会被完全negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和探询与反映，邀请辨识灰度与复杂性，鼓励举例支持多维评价，避免Reinforcement二元化语言。

manifestations: 将一次失败视为“have not前途”的证据
因害怕失败和退学而回避与朋友互动
认为他人难以理解自己的困境

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在对话中反复以“I am not smart enough/not配”自我苛责
过度关注自身表现是否达标，担心被他人评价

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 减少与朋友接触、把恐惧与压力向内Repression并独自承受
在压力下更少求助，转而自我责备与内耗

positive_force: 具有一定的理性Reflection能力（可区分理性与情绪）
Willing to seek professional help and try new strategies (keeping a journal, restructuring thoughts)
拥有一定的社会支持（朋友可倾诉）
negative_force: 灾难化、非黑即白等认知偏差显著
过度预测最坏结果（跳结论）
Social avoidance导致支持减少与负循环
Anxiety导致Sleep and diet disturbance、进一步损害功能

target_behavior.behavior: 与学业相关的灾难化思维与强烈Anxiety
antecedent: 面对学业挑战或作业/考试反馈
思考大学过渡与更高难度课程
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的过度概括与非黑即白评价，担心被negate与失去not yet来（大学过渡压力加剧）
target_behavior.function: Avoids the threat of being evaluated and failing, gaining a temporary sense of control and safety
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety与without望感，睡眠和饮食紊乱，Academic performance affected

antecedent: 在收到负面学业反馈后
Anticipation他人会评价自己的失败
对再次失败的担忧加剧时
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕暴露“without能/not够好”的自我表象，避免被他人negate
target_behavior.function: 避免外界评价与情绪trigger，降低即时Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 孤立感上升，支持系统削弱，Anxiety与despair进一步加剧
